abstract: When the US imposed sweeping tariff increases in 2025, most economic forecasters predicted a sharp rise in consumer prices and significant import disruption. Instead, retail prices rose modestly and import-dependent sectors held up. This column uses data for the 50 largest US trading partners to show that foreign exporters absorbed roughly 40–50% of the 2025 US tariff increases through lower export prices – much more than earlier studies suggested. The absorption was highly unequal: dominant suppliers bore the bulk, while smaller ones passed the tariff on almost fully. The aggregate result vindicates optimal tariff theory. It does not mean the tariffs made America better off.
abstract_zh: 当美国于2025年实施大规模关税上调时，多数经济预测者预计消费者价格将急剧上升，进口将遭受重大干扰。然而，零售价格仅温和上涨，依赖进口的行业也保持了稳定。本文利用美国前50大贸易伙伴的数据表明，外国出口商通过降低出口价格吸收了2025年美国关税上调的约40%至50%——这一比例远高于早期研究的估计。这种吸收效应极不均衡：主导供应商承担了大部分负担，而较小的供应商则几乎将关税完全转嫁出去。总体结果印证了最优关税理论。但这并不意味着关税使美国变得更富裕。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国关税冲击及外国出口商价格吸收，数据覆盖美国前50大贸易伙伴，未明确聚焦中国，核心应用非中国背景。
title: Foreign exporters absorbed nearly half of the 2025 US tariff shock
title_zh: 外国出口商吸收了2025年美国关税冲击的近一半

abstract: Sharp increases in interest rates can reduce the market value of banks’ securities holdings and threaten financial stability. Using euro area data for 2022-2023, this column shows that such losses can also affect monetary policy transmission through a bank collateral channel: banks with larger losses on collateral-eligible securities obtained less interbank funding and cut lending to firms. This effect was only partially offset for domestic subsidiaries in banking groups. The results demonstrate the importance of collateral values in monetary policy transmission and also emphasise the need for further financial integration across borders.
abstract_zh: 利率急剧上升可能降低银行证券持有的市场价值，并威胁金融稳定。利用2022-2023年欧元区数据，本专栏显示，此类损失还可能通过银行抵押品渠道影响货币政策传导：在符合抵押品条件的证券上损失较大的银行，获得的银行间融资减少，并削减了对企业的贷款。这一效应对于银行集团内的国内子公司仅得到部分抵消。研究结果凸显了抵押品价值在货币政策传导中的重要性，并强调了进一步跨境金融整合的必要性。
authors: Mariassunta Giannetti, Martina Jasova, Caterina Mendicino, Dominik Supera
title: The bank collateral channel of monetary policy: Evidence from securities losses
title_zh: 货币政策银行抵押品渠道：来自证券损失的证据
